verdict.rationale: Airbyte's ReadMe-hosted API reference has a live "Try It!" console on each endpoint, with multi-language code snippets and a bearer-token field. Requests run against the real api.airbyte.com, so the examples in the interactive reference are genuinely runnable. The 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the canonical spec is published on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Try It console, and a sandbox mode (calls hit the live API with a real token).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint ("Click Try It! to start a request and see the response here!") with multi-language snippets and a bearer credential field.
The runner executes against the live api.airbyte.com with a real access token.
